spec_match.rationale: Live synthetic audio+video between two peers: require rejects an answer lacking a=cryptex (InvalidAccessError), a require receiver drops clear-header packets (packetsReceived stays 0), negotiate silently falls back — the WPT drop/reject cases.

interactive.rationale: Four scenario buttons each start a real call and stream getStats counters into a table for 6 s; Stop tears down media.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index blurb promises exactly what this page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: This page is the failure-mode angle: up-front rejection, silent packet drop, and silent downgrade, each proven by getStats rather than asserted.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5177732519559168 plus the WebRTC Extensions spec / RFC 9335 section it exercises.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite mirrors WPT RTCConfiguration-rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy.html: default, reflection, enum TypeError, immutability, offer placement, require rejection, negotiate fallback; every probe returns false on unflagged Chrome 153 (0/10) and 7/10 on flagged 153 (fails only on the not-yet-landed "disable" value and setConfiguration immutability).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome 153 flagged, desktop+mobile: honest ~415 packets flowed; drop ~407 sent / 0 received; reject InvalidAccessError; silent ~417 flowed in clear. Unflagged: all four flow in clear with an explicit pre-feature label. Console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: cryptex-require-guard on supported builds checks both outcome and negotiated cryptex state; unsupported runs use a separate fallback id.

design_system.rationale: Shared cryptex-lab.css uses only public/styles.css variables; inverted buttons override both background and color; mark/badge pairs are black on ivory or ivory on black.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/checkboxes with labels or aria-pressed, captions on tables, polite status regions for every async result, visible focus; accessibility tree not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Exercised at 1280x800 (mouse) and 360x740 DPR3 (touch taps) with identical outcomes, no horizontal overflow, zero console errors or failed requests; screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Re-run on Chrome 160 / Canary with the shipped enum
openQuestions.detail: The only build available was Chrome 153; with --enable-blink-features=RtcRtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy it accepts only "negotiate" | "require" (pre webrtc-extensions PR #256). The "disable" branches are coded from the spec and WPT but have not executed. Re-run on a build that accepts "disable" and confirm those cells/verdicts.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Verification here used headless Chrome for Testing 153 via Playwright; chrome-devtools-mcp was not available, so the accessibility tree (aria-pressed states, region names, live-region announcements) was not inspected (project rule 7b).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on narrow mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with caption, wrapper with tabindex=0, role=region and aria-labelledby, container queries to stack cells with injected labels on narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All result tables use .table-wrap (tabindex 0, role=region, aria-labelledby caption, container-type inline-size) and the .stack variant collapses to labelled rows under a 34rem container; the 3x3 policy matrix is intentionally kept as a grid (a stacked matrix loses its row/column meaning) and fits at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region status updates for async results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons with aria-pressed for toggles, visible focus, and a polite status/live region for asynchronous results instead of silent DOM changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Segmented choices are native buttons with aria-pressed; every async outcome is written to a role=status / aria-live=polite readout; :focus-visible outline uses --accent-blue.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets near 44px and let control groups wrap so nothing clips on small screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Buttons and checkbox labels have min-height 44px; control groups use flex-wrap inside repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%,15rem),1fr)) grids.

summary: Strongest runtime evidence in the set: the drop branch is observed in getStats.
